prompt:
Create one tiny 16x16 pixel art resource icon representing collected scientific research data in Mars Crafts.

A compact clearly recognizable scientific magnifying glass with a light steel rim, restrained cyan lens, short dark handle and a small simple data sample or research plate behind it.

The silhouette should communicate scientific investigation and collected research information at a glance.

Authentic Game Boy Advance spacecraft HUD pixel art, crisp dark outlines, limited blue-gray and cyan palette, centered transparent background.

No text, no letters, no numbers, no complex chart, no large document, no frame.
